page: Google Cloud Platform z3-highmem-88-highlssd is a memory-optimized and storage-intensive server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8481C processor. Utilizing the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 88 dedicated vCPUs derived from 44 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 704.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The hardware configuration is bundled with 12 local NVMe SSDs totaling 38,652 GB of high-speed local storage, while containing no GPU accelerators.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 72,975.63 and a PassMark CPU score of 71,866.87, placing it in the top 25% of tested systems. Single-core performance remains in the average tier, as shown by a Geekbench single-core score of 1,704.0. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching 226.47 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 99.47 GB/sec for writes. The instance excels in data-intensive tasks, demonstrating top-tier performance in image processing and strong capabilities in database operations, with Redis SET operations reaching 80.68 million operations per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the z3-highmem-88-highlssd offers a high-density resource profile, balancing massive local NVMe storage capacity with a substantial memory footprint. This makes it highly qualitative for enterprise workloads that require high IOPS and low-latency data access without the overhead of external storage attachments. The instance is optimized for demanding workloads such as large-scale relational databases, in-memory data stores, real-time analytics, and high-throughput data processing pipelines.

This instance is best suited for large-scale databases, in-memory data analytics, and high-throughput data processing.
